scope: A review-only chronology and dispute map for the public James Leininger case literature identified through issue #343. It records attributed claims, documentation timing, exposure pathways, mismatches, source dependencies and unresolved disagreements; it does not adjudicate reincarnation, create a canonical case record or import source content.
decision_boundary: No numerical probability of reincarnation is calculated or implied.
No claim is promoted as a verified hit, miss or accepted evidential edge.
Later commentary and responses share the same case-material lineage and do not count as independent case confirmation.
Military and archival records may test target facts, but do not by themselves establish when or how a child statement was made.
Only public case identifiers and metadata-level summaries are retained; no private child data, images, transcripts or full text are copied.

chronology.event: Museum visit and subsequent repeated exposure to a Blue Angels video are reported before the main statement sequence.
chronology.dispute: The parties disagree about the explanatory weight and completeness of these ordinary-information exposures.

chronology.event: Crash play, nightmares and aviation-related statements are reported as beginning within roughly two months.
chronology.dispute: Exact dates, wording, frequency and contemporaneous preservation are incomplete.

chronology.event: A printed online record associated with the word Natoma is reported.
chronology.dispute: The document's existence, provenance, discovery sequence and causal relation to the child's earlier wording require artifact-level audit.

chronology.event: The name Jack Larsen is reported and later used in family searches.
chronology.dispute: Exact first wording, first fixation and information available during searches remain contested.

chronology.event: Contact with Carol Bowman and related interpretive guidance occurred during the developing case.
chronology.dispute: Sequence, suggestion effects and influence on later elicitation or interpretation require dated-record reconstruction.

chronology.event: An ABC interview was recorded before the reported identification of James Huston Jr.; it was not broadcast.
chronology.dispute: The complete footage, transcript, timestamps, prompts and chain of custody were not audited in this packet.

chronology.event: Attendance at a Natoma Bay reunion and identification of James Huston Jr. are reported.
chronology.dispute: Parties agree this is a crucial cutoff but dispute which statements are securely fixed before it.

chronology.event: Bruce Leininger prepared a retrospective chronology used in later analysis.
chronology.dispute: Its source files, revision history and independence from later knowledge require provenance audit.

chronology.event: A family-authored book presented the developed case narrative.
chronology.dispute: Useful for provenance and later claims, but not a contemporaneous record of the earliest statements.

chronology.event: Tucker conducted his first in-person investigation after major public development of the case.
chronology.dispute: Late entry increases dependence on surviving records and retrospective witnesses.

chronology.event: The case report, critique, response, reply and two-part commentary developed the present methodological dispute.
chronology.dispute: The publications offer competing interpretations of substantially overlapping case materials and are not independent replications.

claim_dispute_matrix.claim_family: Recurring crash, fire and trapped-pilot nightmares or play
claim_dispute_matrix.earliest_record_status: Reported before identification; exact original wording and complete contemporaneous record unavailable here.
claim_dispute_matrix.mismatch_or_ambiguity: Broad imagery admits multiple aviation-related matches unless wording and scoring rules are frozen.
claim_dispute_matrix.proponent_position: Treated as an early behavior cluster consistent with the later target identification.
claim_dispute_matrix.critic_position: Exposure and retrospective reconstruction weaken specificity and chronology.

claim_dispute_matrix.earliest_record_status: A dated 2000-08-27 printout is reported, but the artifact and its causal sequence were not audited.
claim_dispute_matrix.mismatch_or_ambiguity: Spelling, first utterance, search order and adult contribution must be reconstructed.
claim_dispute_matrix.proponent_position: Presented as a specific early item connected to USS Natoma Bay.
claim_dispute_matrix.critic_position: Search context and chronology may permit ordinary acquisition or reconstruction.

claim_dispute_matrix.earliest_record_status: Reported before identification; first verbatim record and search sequence remain incomplete.
claim_dispute_matrix.mismatch_or_ambiguity: Whether the name was spontaneous, stable and uniquely identifying is disputed.
claim_dispute_matrix.proponent_position: Presented as a specific associate-name match.
claim_dispute_matrix.critic_position: Documentation and search contamination are insufficiently controlled.

claim_dispute_matrix.earliest_record_status: Included among reported pre-identification items in Tucker's response.
claim_dispute_matrix.mismatch_or_ambiguity: Huston's fatal aircraft was reported as an FM-2, not a Corsair; earlier Corsair experience is offered as contextual fit.
claim_dispute_matrix.proponent_position: Acknowledges the fatal-flight mismatch but argues the target pilot had earlier Corsair experience.
claim_dispute_matrix.critic_position: Counts the fatal-flight aircraft discrepancy as a material mismatch and warns against post hoc broadening.

claim_dispute_matrix.claim_family: Shot down by the Japanese near Iwo Jima
claim_dispute_matrix.earliest_record_status: Components are reported before identification, but exact wording and combination timing require primary records.
claim_dispute_matrix.mismatch_or_ambiguity: Geographic and event descriptions require predeclared tolerance; Chichi Jima and Iwo Jima must not be silently equated.
claim_dispute_matrix.proponent_position: Treats the cluster as corresponding to Huston's death during the Iwo Jima campaign.
claim_dispute_matrix.critic_position: Challenges specificity, timing and match construction.

claim_dispute_matrix.claim_family: Engine fire or impact and death in water
claim_dispute_matrix.earliest_record_status: Reported in the pre-identification behavior-and-statement set, with wording variants across accounts.
claim_dispute_matrix.mismatch_or_ambiguity: Engine, fire, impact and water elements must be scored separately rather than combined after target selection.
claim_dispute_matrix.proponent_position: Reads the cluster as broadly consistent with the fatal crash account.
claim_dispute_matrix.critic_position: Argues variants and flexible aggregation reduce evidential force.

claim_dispute_matrix.earliest_record_status: Reported as an early item; exact semantics and first preserved record are disputed.
claim_dispute_matrix.mismatch_or_ambiguity: The phrase can support multiple interpretations unless verbatim timing and elicitation context are fixed.
claim_dispute_matrix.proponent_position: Treats it as part of the pre-identification correspondence set.

claim_dispute_matrix.earliest_record_status: Reported after target identification or without secure pre-identification documentation in the reviewed chain.
claim_dispute_matrix.mismatch_or_ambiguity: High leakage risk prevents use in a pre-identification hit denominator.
claim_dispute_matrix.proponent_position: May present some items as additional correspondences with qualifications.
claim_dispute_matrix.critic_position: Excludes or heavily discounts them because normal information transfer cannot be controlled.

missing_denominator_components: Frozen verbatim claim list before target selection
All wrong, unmatched, ambiguous, repeated and later-added statements
Predeclared match tolerances and unitization rules

lineages.rule: Do not count publications reanalyzing these components as independent confirmation.

independence_and_leakage.external_record_rule: Military or archival records may independently establish target facts, but they do not independently establish child-statement timing, wording or freedom from exposure.

unresolved_evidence_requests: Controlled review of the complete original ABC footage, transcript, prompts, timestamps and chain of custody.
Original dated emails and files with preserved metadata rather than later excerpts alone.
Versioned provenance audit of the 2003 chronology and any master timeline.
A frozen, verbatim, pre-identification claim inventory before matching to a target.
A complete inventory of wrong, ambiguous, unmatched, repeated and post-identification claims.
Blind independent coding with predeclared units, match tolerances, decoy targets and base rates.
Independent archival review separating target-fact validation from statement-provenance validation.
Human resolution of the Sudduth critique DOI/date conflict and the Matlock Part 2 publication-date conflict.
conclusion: This packet makes the disagreement auditable but reaches no case-level truth finding. The chronology, denominator, exposure controls, claim unitization and primary-artifact provenance remain insufficiently settled for scoring or promotion.
next_gate: Fresh exact-head review for chain completeness, metadata conflicts, chronology attribution, denominator accounting, leakage, privacy and rights. Any later artifact audit must remain separate and cannot open source-import, evidence, truth, rights, public-synthesis or website gates without an explicit governed decision.
